articles.title: Eclipse Glasses Sold Out? Here's How to Watch Safely Without Them
articles.summary: Eclipse glasses are sold out, but you can still watch Wednesday's solar eclipse using a colander or a homemade pinhole projector. Here's how to do it safely.

articles.title: Trump Says Pro-Israel Lobby's Power Is Fading — and Takes a Jab at Schumer
articles.summary: In a recent interview, President Trump claimed pro-Israel lobbying groups have lost their grip on Congress, and he made controversial remarks about Senator Chuck Schumer, calling him 'virtually a Palestinian.'

articles.title: Progressive Peggy Flanagan Wins Minnesota Senate Primary, Beating Establishment Candidate
articles.summary: Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan defeated centrist Rep. Angie Craig in Minnesota's Democratic Senate primary, a win for progressives. She'll face Republican Michele Tafoya in November.
